sections.title: Science Fiction
sections.description: A speculative creative writing workshop devoted to science fiction. Students can expect to read texts by a variety of practitioners of science fiction, complete regular writing assignments, and workshop writing by their peers. To learn more about this course, visit the Creative Writing Program at https://creative.writing.upenn.edu.
